question: Does a parameter-free reference-aspect consistency factor repair the remaining D15 context leakage when added to the frozen top-two FFA consensus?

predecessor.single_change: Multiply the frozen top-two FFA consensus by exp(-abs(log(candidate aspect / median reference aspect))); preserve candidates, appearance scores, SAM and IoU gate.

masker.contract: Run unchanged native SAM2 only on the three geometry-conditioned top-one boxes.

memory.geometry: Median width/height ratio of the three frozen provider-geometry reference boxes.
memory.score: Frozen top-two FFA consensus multiplied by shape similarity.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider truth is used only after ranking; the gate asks whether both predecessor-reachable queries are localized.

decision_gate.interpretation: Both D15 queries with an existing IoU-0.5 proposal must be selected and refined above IoU 0.5; D15M3 proposal absence remains separate.

forbidden_after_freeze: change reference statistic, shape formula, candidate roster, FFA scores, SAM or IoU gate
use query truth or sibling appearance in ranking
claim consumed D15 evidence as fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This consumed D15 Development ablation can establish only whether parameter-free reference-aspect conditioning repairs context leakage on reachable queries. It cannot repair missing proposals, regain fresh authority, or establish open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
